correctness.rationale: For each comparison r<=leaf, confluence forces exactly the three disjoint root-row cases. The iff is proved in both directions, with no concealed seriality, reflexivity or transitivity assumption. Independent choices yield the binomial labelled formula; every leaf permutation fixed set is counted by its source-cycle/target-cycle gcd profile and Burnside proves the exact unlabelled formula. The included checker exhausts all binary relations for m<=3 and directly counts each permutation-fixed relation through m<=5 using the original quantifiers; formulas evaluated through m=6. These finite checks support but do not replace the symbolic proof.

value.rationale: The KR2023 base frame class is a natural semantic domain of a decidable constructive-bicontent modal logic. Its exact row normal form on the first branching rooted family and exact labelled/unlabelled orbit counts for all leaf cardinalities give structural control over finite semantic models, meaningful beyond hand enumerations. The orbit formula captures nontrivial action of S_m and cannot be inferred by dividing labelled counts by m!. It does not claim classification of arbitrary finite posets or stronger modal axioms.
